bundler <command>

Commands:
  bundler build [entry]  Build the bundle
  bundler watch          Rebuild on change
  bundler serve          Start the dev server

Options:
      --version  Show version number                                   [boolean]
  -m, --mode     Build mode   [string] [choices: "development", "production"]
  -c, --config   Config file path                                       [string]
      --help     Show help                                             [boolean]
